methodology: All baseline people screened for stored class-year evidence. Live source retrieval attempted for all 266 distinct cited year URLs and 245 additional linked institutional pages. Confirm only explicit individual class designations with a resolved school; do not infer graduation from company founding, accelerator cohort, competition date, or academic seniority. Source matches establish the stated class designation, not degree completion or current founder/employment status. Separate degree years are retained. Unavailable or non-explicit sources remain unresolved. Exact name and existing source association used; no fuzzy person merges. PDF columns are excluded from automated matching. Follow-up: 50 additional individual designations manually checked on seven university sources, including visual column-by-column review of MIT PDF pages 3, 5 and 6. GHC conference year replaced only where CMU explicitly supplies an expected degree year.
